description: SQS VPC endpoint AZ impairment - denies Amazon SQS requests made through tagged SQS interface VPC endpoints from subnets in one Availability Zone, while clients in the other Availability Zones keep working

deny-sqs-from-az.description: Add a deny statement for requests from subnets in the target Availability Zone to the endpoint policy of every SQS interface VPC endpoint tagged FIS-Ready=True, wait, then remove it. The statement is also removed if the experiment is stopped.

parameters.documentParameters: {"AvailabilityZone":"<YOUR TARGET AZ>","Duration":"PT10M","TagKey":"FIS-Ready","TagValue":"True","AutomationAssumeRole":"arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR SSM ROLE NAME>"}
